Read this first

  • The pool is small — roughly $1,200 in total when last checked (27 September 2026).
  • A $10 trade moves the price a few percent. A $100 trade moves it by roughly a third. Buy in small amounts.
  • Check the rate you are actually quoted before confirming, not the rate you expected.
  • PCN is not listed on any exchange but our own, exchange.pc.am. This pool is the only market in wPCN, and it is thin. Treat it accordingly.
  • The pool does not set the PCN price. That is the PCN index, the median of real trades between users on exchange.pc.am. A bot of ours keeps the pool near a target set from the index (it can sit below it), but only within a small daily budget.
